'''Nudj''' were [[Lizard/Legends|lizards]] native to the swamps of [[Dagobah/Legends|Dagobah]]. They were small [[Tree/Legends|tree]]-nesting [[Reptile/Legends|reptiles]], favoring trees located in moist caves and marshes.<ref name="card">{{CCG|set=Dagobah Limited|cardname=Nudj}}</ref> The creatures were extremely docile despite their outward appearance. They were [[Force-sensitive/Legends|responsive]] to [[The Force/Legends|Force]] energy and would "bask" in the aura of locations strong in the [[The Force/Legends| Force]]. The Nudj will hiss at those who approach and partially inflate its body to seem larger in order to ward off potential predators.<ref name="FF4">{{FactFile|4|DAG 1-4|Dagobah}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Nudj creature shows significant resemblance to an actual species found on Earth. They look like relatives of Earth lizards, because a real lizard was used to portray the species in the movie.<ref name="familiar creatures">{{SW|url=news/drawing-from-the-present-familiar-creatures-in-a-galaxy-far-far-away|text=Drawing from the Present: Familiar Creatures in a Galaxy Far, Far Away|int=Back from the Drawing Board|nolive=1}}</ref>
